contentBlocks.value:
Kicking off with purpose and heart…

On the morning of August 10, our LAM Project 2025 officially began at Quang Dai Beach (now part of Thu Phu neighborhood, Nam Sam Son ward), bringing together nearly 30 enthusiastic volunteers. With laughter, teamwork, and sandy shoes, we picked up litter piece by piece—giving back to the beach its natural beauty and clear skies.

What made this even more special was the support from the local community. People stopped by to cheer us on, capture moments on video, and energize us with kind words. That encouragement truly kept our spirits high.

By the time we wrapped up our Thanh Hoa stop, nearly 200kg of trash had been collected—a powerful reminder of what we can accomplish together when we care deeply for our environment.

Just sharing a little joy from a day that felt full of meaning.
